SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

3. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
